description: Resolve a free-text NYC address to its tax lot (BBL) and return the property facts: summary, owner of record, building, assessment, last priced deed and open-item counts. Returns the best match with a 0-1 confidence, a plain-English confidence_explanation, a machine-readable match_type, the HTML/Markdown/JSON URLs and up to 4 alternatives. Requires "address". Use get_property for a known BBL/BIN.

address.description: NYC street address, e.g. "98 Grattan St, Brooklyn". Units (Apt 3B), borough and ZIP are optional; a 10-digit BBL or 7-digit BIN also works.

borough.description: Optional: Manhattan, Bronx, Brooklyn, Queens or Staten Island

name: lookup_property
title: Look up a NYC property by address
